# AI-AGENT Notes

## IMPORTANT: types.ts is auto-generated

`types.ts` in this directory is **automatically generated** and **must not be edited manually**.

Any manual changes to `types.ts` will be overwritten the next time the file is regenerated.

If you need to extend or augment types from `types.ts`, define a local type extension in the file where it is needed. For example:

```typescript
type MailsWithSystemFlag = Partial<DatabaseTypes.Mails> & { ignore_mail_limit?: boolean | null };
```
